admission.justification: The fixed harness policy and the all-role freedom are the two designs the packet weighed; the freedom is chosen with a named reconsider condition.

alternatives.option: Every role organises its assignment with whatever its harness offers; the seat still answers, boundary acts stay its own and a sub-agent holds no seat or extra permission.
alternatives.reason: The seat's responsibility and the product's boundaries are what need stating; the harness shape is the harness's.

alternatives.option: Keep the fixed restrictions: read/search-only helpers, one level deep, and the Curator's mandatory fan-out at 100 actionable entries.
alternatives.reason: They prescribed the harness instead of the obligation, and the delivered A2 text and guards remove the 100-entry/depth/read-only wording.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A harness's sub-agents need product-level controls again to keep seat or boundary guarantees.

consequences: The wording tests assert each role's affirmative freedom and boundaries and forbid the removed fixed policy.
Nobody checks itself through a sub-agent and the Curator keeps one writer.
context: The codebase fixed how a seat could organise its own work: read-only helpers for the Curator, a one-level read/search/reference fan-out at a 100-item threshold, and orchestration seats barred from helpers. D92 says the product must not hold a harness to a way of working it has outgrown.
decider: the developer; D92, recorded in the packet's rule 14

evidence: Current successor r2/candidate-freeze.json, repair-report.md, commands.json and compiled capsule/constructor/81 retirement controls; predecessor inventory.md and actual live-witness/witness-supplement.md retained. Historical A1 evidence (not current disposition): All-role wording test; ten retained before/after capsule pairs; knowledge_read base INV-208SQT/RLZ-DT71R6 needs Curator reconsideration under the approved rule14.
